title: Orchard Core: What It Is and What You Can Build | Orchard Core
description:
Orchard Core is both a content management system and an application framework for ASP.NET Core, and it is hard to choose where to start without a picture of the whole.

This video explains what Orchard Core is, shows a site and its admin, and walks through its building blocks: content, themes, widgets, features, recipes and tenants. It ends with the kinds of projects you can build and where to read more.

In this video:
• What Orchard Core is: a framework, and a CMS built on it
• A site and its admin
• Content items and content types
• Themes, widgets and layers
• Features and recipes
• Many sites, one application
• What you can build
• Where to go next
